To revoke Discord authorization, remove Polycord in Discord User Settings > Authorized Apps.
Settings.deleteAccountRetentionNote: Account, profile, settings, voice, saved links, blocks, reports, inbox, local billing, boosts, and push registrations are deleted. Analytics, moderation and abuse logs remain with account links cleared; metadata, notes and IP addresses may remain. Rate limits, Discord moderation restrictions, actor details in other inboxes, payment-provider records and backups are not purged by this action.
